_comment: Controls of the micro-time shifter, drawn by emtk's view_form against the app (gui/app.py), which is the model: attrs are its fields, button actions its methods, `enabled(name)` and `bounds(name)` its hooks. The per-channel shift rows depend on the loaded file, so they are the custom `channel_shifts` section; the MMFDB sample list is the custom `sample_list` section. Each run of fields is a panel of its own (a grid with one label column), so the buttons beside them start at the left edge instead of the label column.

sections.label: Show trigger lines
sections.description: Display the draggable count threshold (yellow) and target bin (green) on the histogram.

sections.label: Log Y
sections.description: Display histogram photon counts on a logarithmic axis.

sections.label: Trigger level
sections.description: Count threshold: auto-align finds, per detector, the first bin up to the peak at or above this level (the rising edge).

sections.label: Target bin
sections.description: Auto-align shifts each detector's rising edge to this micro-time bin.

buttons.label: ⚡  Auto align
buttons.description: Shift each detector so its rising-edge threshold crossing lands on the target bin.

sections.label: Global shift
sections.description: Added to every routing channel's shift; the micro-times wrap modulo the bin count.

buttons.label: 💾  Save shifted…
buttons.description: One file: choose the shifted file's name. Several: choose a folder; one shifted file is written per input. Inputs are never changed.

sections.label: Batch folder
sections.description: Directory for a batch of shifted files; the inputs stay unchanged.

buttons.label: Save batch
buttons.description: Write one shifted file per queued input into the batch folder.

sections.label: Sample ID
sections.description: The MMFDB sample that owns the registered shifted files; choose one from the list or enter its identifier.

buttons.label: 🔄  Refresh samples
buttons.description: Load the sample names from the active MMFDB database.

buttons.label: ➕  New sample…
buttons.description: Create a sample with its full structured definition.

buttons.label: 🗄  Register shifts in MMFDB
buttons.description: Write the shifted files into the object store with their provenance, under the chosen sample, using the verified session.
